name: Lateral Tool Transfer
summary: Adversaries may transfer tools or other files from one system to another to stage adversary tools or other files over the course of an operation. Copying of files may also be performed laterally between internal victim systems to support Lateral Movement with remote Execution using inherent file sharing protocols such as file sharing over SMB to connected network shares. analytics.name: Analytic 1878
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a file written to an Industrial Control System (ICS) host from a remote network share, where the file has an executable or script extension, immediately followed by execution of that file from the same path. Documented in the PIPEDREAM toolkit's modular design, where components transfer files to compromised Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and engineering workstations. analytics.name: Analytic 2135
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies execution on an ICS Linux asset of an executable or script from a path commonly used for inbound file transfer or staging, by a UID outside the approved deployment/administration baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2229
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol file-transfer service placing a file on a field device from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, where the transferred filename pattern matches firmware images or executable payloads inconsistent with the device's normal data exchange profile. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
